description: This Java class 'PduService' handles creation and processing of SNMP Protocol Data Units (PDUs) for SNMP communication, including generating PDUs with specific variables, processing responses, and handling different SNMP versions.

classes.name: PduService
classes.description: Service class for creating and processing SNMP PDUs, supporting different SNMP versions and data types.

methods.name: createPdus
methods.description: Creates a list of SNMP PDUs based on device session, communication configuration, and provided values.

methods.name: createSingleVariablePdu
methods.description: Creates a single SNMP PDU with one variable binding.

methods.name: toSnmpVariable
methods.description: Converts a string value to an SNMP Variable based on the specified DataType.

methods.name: setUpPdu
methods.description: Initializes a PDU object based on SNMP version and session context.

methods.name: processPdus
methods.description: Processes a list of PDUs and response mappings to produce a JSON object with the extracted data.

methods.name: processPdus
methods.description: Extracts variable bindings from PDUs into a map of OID to string values.

methods.name: processValue
methods.description: Processes a value according to its DataType and adds it to the JSON result, handling type cast errors based on configuration.
